setup:
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
k = rng.integers(0, 6, 20000)
centers = rng.normal(0, 6, (6, 30))
df = pd.DataFrame(centers[k] + rng.normal(0, 1, (20000, 30)), columns=[f'x{i}' for i in range(30)])
df['cluster'] = [f'c{v}' for v in k]
df['score'] = df['x0'] * 2 + rng.normal(0, 1, 20000)

steps.name: select c0
steps.eval: const g = a.colorMeta.categories.indexOf('c0'); const v = a['colorValues']; const m = new Uint8Array(v.length); for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) m[i] = v[i] === g ? 1 : 0; a.setSelection(m)

steps.name: tag the selection
steps.eval: a.setTab('annotate'); const t = document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Tag"]'); t.value = 'first'; t.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }))

steps.name: write the tags
assert: h.log.some(l => l.includes('Wrote ' + a.selectedCount + ' labels to df.atlas_tag'))

steps.name: label by the new tag column
tag more rows keeps the earlier tags
steps.eval: const g = a.colorMeta.categories.indexOf('c1'); const v = a['colorValues']; const m = new Uint8Array(v.length); for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) m[i] = v[i] === g ? 1 : 0; a.setSelection(m); a.tagSelection('second', 'atlas_tag')

steps.name: DataMapPlot code runs (tag labels)
steps.eval: a.copyDataMapPlot(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__exec = await (await fetch('/exec', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ code: h.clipboard }) })).json()

steps.name: check the call
steps.eval: window.__exec = null; window.__exec = await (await fetch('/exec', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ code: 'c = _dmp_calls[-1]\nassert c["n"] == 20000, c\nassert c["layers"] == [["Unlabelled", "first", "second"]], c' }) })).json()

steps.name: DataMapPlot code runs (clusters)
steps.eval: window.__exec = null; a.copyDataMapPlot(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__exec = await (await fetch('/exec', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ code: h.clipboard + 'c = _dmp_calls[-1]\nassert c["n"] == 20000 and "Cluster 1" in c["layers"][0], c\n' }) })).json()

steps.name: no labels: code without labels
steps.eval: window.__exec = null; a.setLabelSource(null); a.copyDataMapPlot(); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 300)); window.__exec = await (await fetch('/exec', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ code: h.clipboard + 'assert _dmp_calls[-1]["layers"] == []\n' }) })).json()
